en-US.title: DiskWise
en-US.shortDescription: On-device gallery storage consultant — find reclaimable space safely.
en-US.fullDescription:
DiskWise for Android is an on-device gallery storage consultant. It scans your photos and videos, estimates reclaimable space, and helps you move clutter to Trash — never permanent delete in v1.

WHAT IT DOES
• Find exact duplicates
• Surface screenshots, large videos, and older items
• Ranked recommendations with reclaimable estimates
• Swipe or Delete one item at a time, or Review a selection for bulk cleanup

SAFE CLEANUP
Selected items go to system Trash so you can recover them. DiskWise never empties Trash.

PRIVACY
All analysis runs on your device. Photo contents are not uploaded to a cloud service.

Learn more at https://diskwise.suherman.net
en-US.releaseNotes: Deleting one photo is faster: swipe left, tap Delete in the list, or Delete from preview — goes straight to the system Trash UI. Bulk Review still confirms before moving multiple items.
